set.body:
Outcome: a reproducible bounded baseline identifies actual cost before candidate budgets or backends are broadened.
Scope: existing benchmark/tool location; synthetic state/recall workloads and instrumentation that does not change model results. New dependencies/modules need prior ADR approval.
Acceptance: freeze a small workload matrix varying recall length, source size, admitted candidate states, ties/overflow and number of requested weighted members. Account for source-level scoring work separately from retained candidates. Measure scoring, transition construction, forward/backward plus Viterbi/refinement where applicable, retained flow and export; include peak process/heap memory, allocations where available, artifact bytes and sum_i S_i*S_(i+1). State instrumentation limits rather than attributing whole-process RSS to one stage. Record hardware/runtime, code/config/input hashes, warmup/repetitions, timings with variability and exits, deterministic output parity and refused workloads. Use conservative bounded sizes and stop before resource exhaustion; do not broaden budgets to force a stress result. Benchmark existing paired and weighted execution immediately; reference-only comparison is added by G when available. Identify an observed safe operating envelope and a recommended next action (including no optimization); resource acceptance targets are explicit proposals requiring owner choice, not invented universal limits.
Evidence: runnable command, committed synthetic generator/receipts and independently checked output equivalence. No speedup claim without matched correct outputs; no generic new backend or solver in this child.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
